# SERO Package Test

This document demonstrates the functionality of the SERO (Spatial Emergency Response Optimization) package.

## 1. Package Installation and Loading

```{r load-packages}
# Load required packages
library(SERO)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Check package version and functions
packageVersion("SERO")
```

## 2. Load Sample Data

```{r load-data}
# Load the built-in sample data
data <- sero_load_data()

# Display data structure
str(data, max.level = 1)

# Check what data components we have
names(data)
```

## 3. Data Validation

```{r validate-data}
# Check data structure first
cat("Data layers available:\n")
print(names(data))

# Basic data info
for (layer in names(data)) {
  if (inherits(data[[layer]], "sf")) {
    cat(sprintf("- %s: %d features\n", layer, nrow(data[[layer]])))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("- %s: %s\n", layer, class(data[[layer]])))
  }
}
```

## 4. Hotspot Analysis

```{r hotspot-analysis}
# Perform hotspot analysis on accidents
if ("accident" %in% names(data) && inherits(data$accident, "sf")) {
  
  # Check accident data structure
  cat("Accident data structure:\n")
  print(head(data$accident))
  cat("\nAccident coordinates:\n")
  print(st_geometry(data$accident))
  
  # Simple hotspot visualization
  cat("\nAccident hotspot analysis:\n")
  
  # Basic plotting - use districts as boundary
  if ("districts" %in% names(data)) {
    plot(st_geometry(data$districts), main = "Accidents in Study Area")
    plot(st_geometry(data$accident), add = TRUE, col = "red", pch = 16)
  } else {
    # Plot just accidents if no boundary available
    plot(st_geometry(data$accident), main = "Accident Locations", col = "red", pch = 16)
  }
  
} else {
  cat("Accident data not found or not in sf format\n")
}
```

## 5. Optimal Location Analysis

```{r optimal-locations}
# Find optimal emergency service locations using basic spatial analysis
if ("accident" %in% names(data) && "districts" %in% names(data)) {
  cat("Finding optimal emergency service locations using spatial data...\n")
  
  # Simple analysis - find center of accident clusters
  accident_coords <- st_coordinates(data$accident)
  center_x <- mean(accident_coords[,1])
  center_y <- mean(accident_coords[,2])
  
  cat(sprintf("Centroid of accidents: (%.2f, %.2f)\n", center_x, center_y))
  
  # Basic visualization
  plot(st_geometry(data$districts), main = "Study Area with Accident Centroid")
  plot(st_geometry(data$accident), add = TRUE, col = "red", pch = 16, cex = 0.5)
  points(center_x, center_y, col = "blue", pch = 19, cex = 2)
  legend("topright", c("Accidents", "Centroid"), col = c("red", "blue"), pch = c(16, 19))
  
} else {
  cat("Required spatial data not available\n")
}
```

## 6. Route Analysis

```{r route-analysis}
# Basic distance analysis between accidents and optimal location
if ("accident" %in% names(data) && exists("center_x") && exists("center_y")) {
  cat("Calculating distances from optimal location to accidents...\n")
  
  # Calculate distances
  accident_coords <- st_coordinates(data$accident)
  distances <- sqrt((accident_coords[,1] - center_x)^2 + (accident_coords[,2] - center_y)^2)
  
  cat(sprintf("Average distance to accidents: %.2f meters\n", mean(distances)))
  cat(sprintf("Maximum distance: %.2f meters\n", max(distances)))
  cat(sprintf("Minimum distance: %.2f meters\n", min(distances)))
  
  # Plot distance distribution
  hist(distances, main = "Distance Distribution from Optimal Location", 
       xlab = "Distance (meters)", col = "lightblue", breaks = 10)
  
} else {
  cat("Cannot calculate routes without spatial data\n")
}
```

## 7. Data Summary and Statistics

```{r data-summary}
# Basic statistics about the dataset
cat("Dataset Summary:\n")
cat("===============\n")

for (layer_name in names(data)) {
  layer <- data[[layer_name]]
  cat(sprintf("\n%s:\n", layer_name))
  
  if (inherits(layer, "sf")) {
    cat(sprintf("  - Type: Spatial features (sf)\n"))
    cat(sprintf("  - Features: %d\n", nrow(layer)))
    cat(sprintf("  - Columns: %d\n", ncol(layer)))
    cat(sprintf("  - CRS: %s\n", ifelse(is.na(st_crs(layer)), "Not set", as.character(st_crs(layer)))))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("  - Type: %s\n", class(layer)[1]))
    if (is.data.frame(layer)) {
      cat(sprintf("  - Rows: %d\n", nrow(layer)))
      cat(sprintf("  - Columns: %d\n", ncol(layer)))
    }
  }
}
```

## 8. Package Function Testing

```{r function-testing}
# Test which SERO functions are available
cat("Available SERO functions:\n")
sero_functions <- ls("package:SERO", pattern = "^sero_")
if (length(sero_functions) > 0) {
  for (func in sero_functions) {
    cat(sprintf("  - %s\n", func))
  }
} else {
  cat("  No SERO functions found with sero_ prefix\n")
}

# Test core function existence
core_functions <- c("sero_optimal", "sero_data", "sero_hotspots")
cat("\nCore function availability:\n")
for (func in core_functions) {
  exists_func <- exists(func, mode = "function")
  cat(sprintf("  - %s: %s\n", func, ifelse(exists_func, "Available", "Not found")))
}
```
